_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. core.marketing palette/type/radii/motion and the violet, light and gray sets are declared values from front.com's compiled design layer (raw/css-classes.json), each role sourced to its class and [data-theme] scope. core.primitive is the app shell's resolved --color-primitive-* ramps; core.froyo is the full Froyo build the Companion messenger ships (declared in companion.frontapp.com's @layer tokens, var() aliases resolved through the same sheet). The app and dark sets are the signin shell's resolved --color-* semantics, companion/companionDark its [data-theme] semantics, help the Knowledge Base's :root block. component.* holds measured computed-style and geometry evidence, each leaf sourced to the component and state it was read from.
